burns-courts.description: Eight outdoor pickleball courts at Burns Regional Park, near Sterling Ranch Avenue and Middle Fork Street.
visitNotes: CAB lists weekday access from 7 a.m. to dusk and weekend access from 8 a.m. to dusk.
Bring your own paddles and balls. Check CourtReserve for the current open-play and reservation schedule.
Street parking is available near Sterling Ranch Avenue and Middle Fork Street.
unknowns: Same-day availability and weather closures must be checked with CAB.
burns-courts.access: CAB offers resident and nonresident reservations; check the booking portal for current availability and fees.

burns.description: The first completed amenity is the eight-court pickleball facility. More of the regional park is planned in later phases.

overlook-pool.description: The Overlook’s seasonal outdoor pool. Use the pool page for the latest opening and closure information.

school51.description: Sterling Ranch’s new neighborhood elementary school is under construction at 8220 Piney River Avenue. DCSD targets August 2027 for opening, with enrollment anticipated in November 2026.
visitNotes: The working name is Elementary School 51. Use DCSD’s project page for naming, attendance-boundary and enrollment updates.
unknowns: Final attendance boundaries and enrollment opening date still need confirmation.

library.description: The planned library at 8285 Piney River Avenue includes study and conference rooms, an event hall, children’s space and outdoor gathering areas.
visitNotes: The project targets 2027. Planned rooms and services are not open for use yet.
unknowns: The exact opening date and room-booking start are not confirmed.

john-adams.description: John Adams Academy’s Sterling Ranch campus is at 7979 Butte Creek Street. The operator describes a K–8 start for fall 2026.
john-adams.access: School campus. Playground or sports-area access outside school activities is not established.

primrose.access: School facilities are for enrolled families and authorized visitors. These are not public neighborhood playgrounds.

prospect-park.description: An all-abilities playground, turf area and event shell anchor Prospect Park. CAB also lists basketball and other sports facilities; later phases remain separate below.
unknowns: Confirm current availability of each sports area, entrance details and restroom access.

prospect-basketball.description: CAB lists a separate basketball-court facility within Prospect Park at 8158 Monte Vista Circle.
unknowns: Current court availability and booking conditions still need checking.

prospect-next.description: CAB announced a summer 2026 start for Phase 2, including the Beach Club pool. That announcement does not establish that the pool is open.
unknowns: Actual construction progress and opening date are not yet confirmed.

outcrop.description: A Parkvale park planned with a climbing wall, rockslide, nature play and picnic/shade areas. The developer’s summer 2026 target needs a current opening check.

peekaboo.description: An Ascent pocket park with a dual-slide play structure and shaded picnic shelter.

willow-creek.description: A trailhead and gathering place by Willow Creek. CAB places Trailhead Park near Mount Kataka and Mount Ouray; the name match remains under review.

broadstone.access: These amenities belong to the apartment community. Public or general Sterling Ranch resident access is not established.

prose.access: These amenities belong to the apartment community. The dog park is not established as a public CAB off-leash park.

ranch-social.description: Sterling Center’s shared food, drink and gathering venue, with tenant businesses and outdoor play/seating areas.

food-trucks.description: Rotating food trucks stop at Ranch Social. Check the daily schedule for who is serving and when.

farmers-market.description: The 2026 market runs at Providence Park on Wednesdays, June 24 through October 14, from 3–7 p.m. or sellout.

visitNotes: Sterling Center, Suite 120. The operator lists a midday lunch closure, so check office hours before visiting.

zebulon.description: Douglas County reports grading and preparation for infrastructure. The proposed sports facilities are not open.

mccormick.description: A neighborhood playground and gathering spot on Palmer Lake Avenue, set inside the curved residential street. Select the playground or shelter to see what is here.
visitNotes: Use Palmer Lake Avenue to orient yourself; the map marker identifies the park area.

mccormick-play.description: The play structure sits within McCormick Park’s central recreation space.

pioneer.description: A neighborhood park on Arapahoe Peak Street with a large grassy area, a playground and a shelter for gathering.
visitNotes: Look for the park among the homes on Arapahoe Peak Street.

pioneer-play.description: A play structure beside Pioneer Park’s large grassy recreation area.
